_comment: Terminology is not a style choice. Each entry names a wording that must not ship and the wording that replaces it, with the reason a reviewer can check. VERBA proposes additions through a recorded room decision and never invents one silently. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the package copy before any gate passes.
